title: Hardspace: Shipbreaker — Survival, Reproduction, Illusion #Shorts
description:
The bleak reading of Hardspace: Shipbreaker is also the most testable one. Hardspace: Shipbreaker is an action-adventure simulation video game developed by Blackbird Interactive and originally published by Focus Entertainment. In the game, the player works as a ship breaker by exploring and dismantling abandoned spacecraft in search of useful materials, while at the same time tackling the labor relations issues within their employer.

The unconscious does not argue with Hardspace: Shipbreaker; it simply acts first. Screen Rant gave the title 4 stars out of 5 and praised the engaging nature of the shipbreaking gameplay loop while noting a minor lack of polish. She compared the Lynx Corporation's shipyard to a company town, with the work being paid in company scrip, as an example of the game's effective critique of modern capitalism.
